item.title: Trusting UGREEN Was a Mistake.
item.description:
UGREEN Charger

UGREEN had always seemed like one of the more trustworthy brands on AliExpress. I usually avoid buying electronics from AliExpress, but about three months ago, I saw the charger below featured in a YouTuber’s recommended products. Trusting the UGREEN brand, I decided to give it a try.

Well, that turned out to be a mistake.

The first time I plugged it in, the LED seemed to light up briefly, indicating that it was connected. But after that, it completely stopped working. No response whatsoever.
